headline: A 2012 executive order on how the federal government supports safe development of unconventional US natural gas, such as shale gas.
what_it_does: The order addresses the federal government's role in developing unconventional natural gas inside the United States. Based on its title, it directs federal efforts to support producing this gas in a way that is safe and responsible. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, agency duties, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order likely guides how agencies handle their work related to unconventional natural gas development.
Companies developing unconventional gas may be affected by how the federal government oversees and supports this work.

who_it_affects.group: People living near natural gas development sites
who_it_affects.how: The order's focus on safe development relates to communities where this gas is produced.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 13, 2012; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
